discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in c12baa7. `getHeadroomStatus()` now keeps the top-level `installed` flag from the CLI binary probe and only lifts `version` / `extras` from `getInstalledHeadroomExtras()`, so a `pip list` failure no longer flips the dashboard into `installed:false`.

Fixed in c12baa7. `refreshHeadroomStatus()` now clears `headroomExtras` / `pendingExtras` when Headroom is not installed, when the extras fetch fails, and when the outer status fetch fails, so the UI no longer keeps stale version/extras state.
Fixed in 46ebf215: the Responses probe now accepts 2xx plus explicit transient statuses (408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504). It rejects 405, 410, and 422; focused tests cover these cases.

`saveModels` ignores the POST response. If the user deselects the last model and closes the modal, this endpoint returns 400 because `models` is empty, but local state still shows no models while the previous `models.yml` contents remain persisted. Check `res.ok`; on failure, surface the error and rehydrate via `checkStatus()` (or make deselect-all a supported persistence path).
